titulo: The Clash of Two Eras: Capcom Is Preparing a 'Crossover' Between Resident Evil Timelines
texto: According to producer Jun Takeuchi, the development team has been actively mapping out the exact moment when the saga's past and present will perfectly align. The executive has categorized this narrative convergence as a true internal "crossover" for the franchise. Historically, the modern Resident Evil era has operated under a clear dual strategy: - **The Present Timeline:** Titles like Resident Evil 7: Biohazard, Resident Evil Village, and Resident Evil: Requiem focus on pushing the overarching story forward. These games introduce new threats, fresh protagonists like Ethan Winters, and the latest developments in modern bioterrorism. - **The Past Timeline:** The reimagined classics (Resident Evil 2, 3, and 4 Remakes) serve not only to modernize gameplay but to tie up loose ends in the original lore, re-establishing the weight of classic figures and corporations with newfound narrative depth. Resident Evil: Requiem, released in early 2026, is part of the preparation for this convergence, not its culmination. According to Takeuchi, Requiem's references to Umbrella and Spencer and the return of Raccoon City are groundwork for a future crossover, which will come once the remakes catch up with the era of the numbered games. The game resurrected the foundational ghosts of the series by sending veteran Leon S. Kennedy and new protagonist, FBI analyst Grace Ashcroft, back into the ruins of Raccoon City—including a chilling return to the iconic R.P.D. station. The plot delivered direct references to the all-powerful Umbrella Corporation and its enigmatic founder, Oswell E. Spencer, seamlessly bridging the classic legacy with entirely new survival threats. This strategic move confirmed that the recent remakes were never just an exercise in nostalgia; they were crucial pieces of a much larger puzzle. By reintroducing players to the horrors of Raccoon City and Umbrella in the remakes, Capcom laid the perfect groundwork for those same threats to haunt the modern story arc, groundwork that continued in the highly acclaimed Requiem and whose meaning, according to Takeuchi, should become clear before the series' 40th anniversary. Now, fans must wait to see how classic veterans and the new generation of survivors will continue to collide in this ambitious narrative roadmap. *Correction (October 16, 2026): an earlier version of this article said the crossover between Resident Evil's timelines materialized and culminated in Requiem. In fact, Jun Takeuchi described Requiem as preparation for a future crossover, when the remakes catch up with the numbered games, with its meaning to become clear before the series' 40th anniversary.*

context: Jun Takeuchi, Resident Evil's executive producer, made the comments in a Japanese magazine special for the series' 30th anniversary, picked up in English by VGC, GamesRadar and Nintendo Life around October 1. He said the series is developed on two tracks, remakes and new numbered entries, and that “someday, the remake series will catch up with the era of the numbered titles”, with preparation under way since Resident Evil Village.

He named Umbrella, Spencer and the return of Raccoon City in Resident Evil Requiem as groundwork for that crossover. Requiem launched on February 27, 2026, and passed 6 million units by March 16, the fastest in the series according to Capcom.
known: Takeuchi said Capcom develops Resident Evil on two tracks: remakes and new numbered games.
He said preparation for an eventual crossover between the two has been gradual since Resident Evil Village.
He cited Umbrella, Spencer and Raccoon City's return in Requiem as part of that groundwork.
Requiem sold more than 6 million units in about 17 days, a series record for speed, according to Capcom.
A remake of Code Veronica is on the way, and Capcom has said it treats it as seriously as a numbered entry.
unknown: Takeuchi gave no date for when the remakes will reach the numbered era or what the crossover will look like.
Remakes of Resident Evil 5 and 6 are not confirmed, despite fan readings of the quote.
Reports of new remakes of Resident Evil 0 and the first game remain unconfirmed.
Takeuchi said he will explain later the “answer” and “question” hidden in the Requiem title.
take: Takeuchi's comment is less a reveal than a statement of logistics. If Capcom keeps remaking older games, the remakes will eventually run up against Resident Evil 7, the game he calls a turning point. Saying the studio has a plan for that moment is sensible, and the Umbrella material in Requiem shows the plan already shaping story choices. It does not confirm any specific remake, and it does not make Requiem the crossover itself.

For players, the practical reading is that both lines will share more characters and lore, so the remakes stop being standalone nostalgia and become canon the new games lean on. The risk is that new entries get harder to follow for anyone who skipped the remakes. Requiem's sales suggest the current balance works. The next concrete test is the Code Veronica remake, which Capcom already describes as being as vital as a numbered entry.

Ele disse que a franquia é desenvolvida em duas frentes, remakes e novos jogos numerados, e que “um dia a série de remakes vai alcançar a era dos títulos numerados”, com preparação em andamento desde Resident Evil Village.

Ele citou Umbrella, Spencer e a volta de Raccoon City em Resident Evil Requiem como base para esse crossover. Requiem saiu em 27 de fevereiro de 2026 e passou de 6 milhões de unidades até 16 de março, o ritmo mais rápido da série segundo a Capcom.

take: A fala de Takeuchi é menos uma revelação e mais uma questão de logística. Se a Capcom continuar refazendo jogos antigos, os remakes vão acabar esbarrando em Resident Evil 7, o jogo que ele chama de ponto de virada. Dizer que existe um plano para esse momento faz sentido, e o material sobre a Umbrella em Requiem mostra esse plano já influenciando a história. Na prática, as duas linhas devem compartilhar cada vez mais personagens e mitologia, e os remakes deixam de ser só nostalgia para virar o cânone em que os jogos novos se apoiam. O risco é a série ficar mais difícil de acompanhar para quem pulou os remakes. As vendas de Requiem sugerem que o equilíbrio atual funciona. O próximo teste concreto é o remake de Code Veronica, que a Capcom já descreve como tão importante quanto um jogo numerado.

No confirma ningún remake concreto ni convierte a Requiem en el crossover.

El riesgo es que la serie resulte más difícil de seguir para quien se saltó los remakes. Las ventas de Requiem sugieren que el equilibrio actual funciona. La próxima prueba concreta será el remake de Code Veronica, que Capcom ya describe como tan importante como una entrega numerada.

According to producer Jun Takeuchi, the development team has been actively mapping out the exact moment when the saga's past and present will perfectly align. The executive has categorized this narrative convergence as a true internal "crossover" for the franchise.

Historically, the modern Resident Evil era has operated under a clear dual strategy:

  • The Present Timeline: Titles like Resident Evil 7: Biohazard, Resident Evil Village, and Resident Evil: Requiem focus on pushing the overarching story forward. These games introduce new threats, fresh protagonists like Ethan Winters, and the latest developments in modern bioterrorism.

  • The Past Timeline: The reimagined classics (Resident Evil 2, 3, and 4 Remakes) serve not only to modernize gameplay but to tie up loose ends in the original lore, re-establishing the weight of classic figures and corporations with newfound narrative depth.

Resident Evil: Requiem, released in early 2026, is part of the preparation for this convergence, not its culmination. According to Takeuchi, Requiem's references to Umbrella and Spencer and the return of Raccoon City are groundwork for a future crossover, which will come once the remakes catch up with the era of the numbered games.

The game resurrected the foundational ghosts of the series by sending veteran Leon S. Kennedy and new protagonist, FBI analyst Grace Ashcroft, back into the ruins of Raccoon City—including a chilling return to the iconic R.P.D. station. The plot delivered direct references to the all-powerful Umbrella Corporation and its enigmatic founder, Oswell E. Spencer, seamlessly bridging the classic legacy with entirely new survival threats.

This strategic move confirmed that the recent remakes were never just an exercise in nostalgia; they were crucial pieces of a much larger puzzle. By reintroducing players to the horrors of Raccoon City and Umbrella in the remakes, Capcom laid the perfect groundwork for those same threats to haunt the modern story arc, groundwork that continued in the highly acclaimed Requiem and whose meaning, according to Takeuchi, should become clear before the series' 40th anniversary.

Now, fans must wait to see how classic veterans and the new generation of survivors will continue to collide in this ambitious narrative roadmap.

titulo_es: El choque de dos eras: Capcom está preparando un 'crossover' entre las líneas temporales de Resident Evil
texto_es: Capcom se dirige oficialmente hacia una colisión entre las dos narrativas que han impulsado el resurgimiento moderno de Resident Evil. Después de años operando en frentes paralelos —con juegos totalmente nuevos que avanzan la cronología mientras los remakes reescriben meticulosamente el pasado—, el estudio ha confirmado que estas dos líneas temporales inevitablemente se cruzarán. Según el productor Jun Takeuchi, el equipo de desarrollo ha estado trazando activamente el momento exacto en que el pasado y el presente de la saga se alinearán a la perfección. El ejecutivo ha catalogado esta convergencia narrativa como un verdadero "crossover" interno para la franquicia. Históricamente, la era moderna de Resident Evil ha operado bajo una clara estrategia dual: - **La línea del presente:** Títulos como Resident Evil 7: Biohazard, Resident Evil Village y Resident Evil: Requiem se centran en empujar la historia general hacia adelante. Estos juegos introducen nuevas amenazas, nuevos protagonistas como Ethan Winters y los últimos desarrollos del bioterrorismo moderno. - **La línea del pasado:** Los clásicos reimaginados (los remakes de Resident Evil 2, 3 y 4) no solo sirven para modernizar la jugabilidad, sino para atar cabos sueltos en la historia original, restableciendo el peso de figuras y corporaciones clásicas con una nueva profundidad narrativa. Resident Evil: Requiem, lanzado a principios de 2026, forma parte de la preparación para esta convergencia, no es su culminación. Según Takeuchi, las referencias a Umbrella y a Spencer y el regreso de Raccoon City en Requiem son preparación para un futuro crossover, que llegará cuando los remakes alcancen la era de los títulos numerados. El juego resucitó a los fantasmas fundamentales de la serie al enviar al veterano Leon S. Kennedy y a la nueva protagonista, la analista del FBI Grace Ashcroft, de vuelta a las ruinas de Raccoon City, incluyendo un escalofriante regreso a la icónica comisaría del R.P.D. La trama ofreció referencias directas a la todopoderosa Corporación Umbrella y a su enigmático fundador, Oswell E. Spencer, uniendo a la perfección el legado clásico con amenazas de supervivencia completamente nuevas. Este movimiento estratégico confirmó que los remakes recientes nunca fueron solo un ejercicio de nostalgia; eran piezas cruciales de un rompecabezas mucho más grande. Al reintroducir a los jugadores a los horrores de Raccoon City y Umbrella en las recreaciones, Capcom preparó el terreno perfecto para que esas mismas amenazas acecharan el arco argumental moderno, una preparación que continuó en el aclamado Requiem y cuyo sentido, según Takeuchi, debería quedar claro antes del 40.º aniversario de la saga. Ahora, los fans deben esperar para ver cómo los veteranos clásicos y la nueva generación de supervivientes continuarán colisionando en esta ambiciosa hoja de ruta narrativa. *Corrección (16 de octubre de 2026): una versión anterior de este artículo decía que el crossover entre las líneas temporales de Resident Evil se materializó y culminó en Requiem. En realidad, Jun Takeuchi describió Requiem como preparación para un futuro crossover, cuando los remakes alcancen a los títulos numerados, cuyo sentido debería quedar claro antes del 40.º aniversario de la saga.*

titulo: Hurricanes and Storms: The Impressive New Weather System in GTA 6
texto: According to Owen Shepherd, Rockstar's Vice President of Art for Lighting and Rendering, the team has completely rebuilt the weather system to make it much more localized and persistent, achieving a scale never before seen in the franchise. Check out the main highlights of the newly confirmed weather and storm mechanics: - **Hurricanes and Tropical Storms:** The game will feature the extreme weather phenomena that are a trademark of Florida. During these powerful storms, players will face torrential rain, heavy winds, thunder, and lightning, with water realistically running off roofs and utility poles along the streets. - **Localized and Dynamic Weather:** The new system features fully dynamic cloudscapes, allowing you to actually see storms moving across the map. It will be perfectly possible to stand in a dry, sunny area while watching heavy rain fall in the distance in another region of Leonida. - **New Wind System:** The wind will affect the open world in incredibly immersive ways. The game will feature different patterns of air currents, such as offshore breezes after sunset and convective updrafts. In practice, wind gusts will blow hair and debris around, create ripples on the water's surface, and bend the tall grass in the swamps. - **Persistent Visual Impact:** Rain will leave real marks on the environment even after the storm has passed. Lasting puddles will remain on the roads indicating the exact path of the storm, and rainbows can form depending on the precise sunlight and humidity conditions. This impressive attention to detail reinforces Rockstar's goal of creating a much more reactive open world. Nature in Leonida won't just serve as a static backdrop, but rather as an active, unpredictable, and shifting force during Jason and Lucia's daily routines and explorations. Stay tuned to our website for more updates and full coverage as soon as new information about GTA 6 emerges! *Correction (October 16, 2026): an earlier version of this article mentioned "volumetric clouds" and "sea breezes after sunset." In fact, Rockstar's Owen Shepherd described fully dynamic cloudscapes, offshore breezes after sunset and convective updrafts.*

context: The weather details come from Game Informer's 14-page GTA VI cover story, published September 29. In it, Owen Shepherd, Rockstar's vice president of art for lighting and rendering, said the team “re-engineered” the weather system to make it “much more localized and persistent”. The same piece describes a Leonida map twice the size of Grand Theft Auto V's, split into six regions including Vice City, the Leonida Keys and the Everglades-inspired Grassrivers.

Storms are an obvious fit for a game modeled on Florida, and fans had long read old Rockstar job listings about large-scale destruction as a hint. Rockstar has now confirmed hurricanes, but not what they do to play.
known: Rockstar confirmed tropical storms and hurricanes, with heavy clouds, strong winds, thunder, lightning and heavy rain.
Weather is localized: players can stand in sunshine while a storm hits another part of the map.
Wet surfaces and puddles linger after the rain has moved on, and rainbows can form in the right light.
The wind system accounts for offshore breezes after sunset, rising warm air and buildings that block gusts, moving hair, debris, water and swamp grass.
unknown: Rockstar has not said how often hurricanes happen, or whether they are random or tied to missions.
There is no word on whether storms cause flooding or damage property.
Whether weather changes driving or water physics, as a 2023 report claimed, has not been officially confirmed.
take: Localized weather is the most important change here, more than the hurricanes. A storm you can watch rolling in, and puddles that tell you where it went, turn weather from a filter over the screen into part of the geography. On a map this large, that should make long drives and boat trips feel less uniform, and it plays to Rockstar's strength in lighting, which is exactly Shepherd's department.

The hurricanes deserve more caution. Rockstar chose its words carefully: storms bring wind, rain and dense atmosphere, and nobody has said they flatten buildings or flood streets. Given how much a full hurricane would disrupt traffic and missions, we would expect them to be rare or scripted rather than something that can strike at any hour, though that is our reading, not Rockstar's. The detail worth checking at launch on November 19 is whether rain changes how cars handle and how people on the street react. That is the point where a visual system becomes a gameplay one.

context: Os detalhes sobre o clima vêm da reportagem de capa de 14 páginas da Game Informer sobre GTA VI, publicada em 29 de setembro. Nela, Owen Shepherd, vice-presidente de arte para iluminação e renderização da Rockstar, disse que a equipe “reformulou” o sistema de clima para deixá-lo “muito mais localizado e persistente”. A mesma matéria descreve um mapa de Leonida com o dobro do tamanho do de GTA V, dividido em seis regiões, entre elas Vice City, Leonida Keys e Grassrivers, inspirada nos Everglades.

Tempestades combinam com um jogo baseado na Flórida, e fãs já viam em antigas vagas de emprego da Rockstar sobre destruição em larga escala um indício disso. A Rockstar confirmou os furacões, mas não o efeito deles no jogo.
known: A Rockstar confirmou tempestades tropicais e furacões, com nuvens carregadas, ventos fortes, trovões, raios e chuva pesada.
O clima é localizado: dá para estar no sol enquanto uma tempestade atinge outra parte do mapa.
Superfícies molhadas e poças continuam no chão depois que a chuva passa, e arco-íris podem se formar com a luz certa.
O vento leva em conta a brisa da terra para o mar após o pôr do sol, o ar quente subindo e prédios que bloqueiam rajadas, mexendo cabelo, detritos, água e o capim dos pântanos.
unknown: A Rockstar não disse com que frequência os furacões acontecem nem se são aleatórios ou ligados a missões.
Não há informação sobre alagamentos ou danos a construções.
Não foi confirmado oficialmente se o clima altera a direção ou a física da água, como dizia um relato de 2023.
take: O clima localizado é a mudança mais importante da lista, mais até que os furacões. Uma tempestade que você vê chegando, e poças que mostram por onde ela passou, transformam o clima de um filtro sobre a tela em parte da geografia. Num mapa desse tamanho, isso deve deixar viagens longas de carro ou barco menos repetitivas, e joga a favor de um ponto forte da Rockstar, a iluminação, que é justamente a área de Shepherd.

Os furacões pedem mais cautela. A Rockstar escolheu bem as palavras: as tempestades trazem vento, chuva e atmosfera densa, e ninguém disse que derrubam prédios ou alagam ruas. Pelo tamanho do transtorno que um furacão completo causaria no trânsito e nas missões, esperamos que sejam raros ou roteirizados, e não algo que surge a qualquer hora, mas essa é a nossa leitura, não a da Rockstar. O que vale observar no lançamento, em 19 de novembro, é se a chuva muda o comportamento dos carros e das pessoas na rua. É aí que um sistema visual vira mecânica de jogo.

El viento tiene en cuenta la brisa de tierra hacia el mar tras el atardecer, el aire caliente que sube y los edificios que frenan las ráfagas, y mueve cabello, basura, agua y pasto de los pantanos.

titulo_pt: Furacões e Tempestades: O Impressionante Novo Sistema de Clima de GTA 6
texto_pt: A tão aguardada representação do estado de Leonida em Grand Theft Auto VI não trará apenas vida selvagem diversificada, mas também as forças incontroláveis da natureza. Uma nova cobertura especial da revista Game Informer, revelada ontem, detalhou o novo e revolucionário sistema climático que promete transformar a exploração no próximo grande título da Rockstar Games. titulo_es: Huracanes y tormentas: El impresionante nuevo sistema meteorológico en GTA 6
texto_es: La tan esperada representación del estado de Leonida en Grand Theft Auto VI no solo traerá una fauna diversa, sino también las fuerzas incontrolables de la naturaleza. Una nueva cobertura especial de la revista Game Informer, revelada ayer, detalló el revolucionario sistema meteorológico que promete transformar la exploración en el próximo gran título de Rockstar Games. Según Owen Shepherd, vicepresidente de arte de iluminación y renderizado de Rockstar, el equipo ha reconstruido por completo el sistema del clima para hacerlo mucho más localizado y persistente, alcanzando una escala nunca antes vista en la franquicia. Echa un vistazo a los aspectos más destacados de las nuevas mecánicas de clima y tormentas confirmadas: - **Huracanes y tormentas tropicales:** El juego presentará los fenómenos climáticos extremos que son marca registrada de Florida. Durante estas poderosas tormentas, los jugadores se enfrentarán a lluvias torrenciales, fuertes vientos, truenos y relámpagos, con el agua escurriendo de manera realista por los tejados y los postes de luz a lo largo de las calles. - **Clima localizado y dinámico:** El nuevo sistema cuenta con formaciones de nubes totalmente dinámicas, lo que permite ver cómo las tormentas se mueven por el mapa. Será perfectamente posible estar en una zona seca y soleada mientras observas cómo cae una fuerte lluvia a lo lejos en otra región de Leonida. - **Nuevo sistema de viento:** El viento afectará el mundo abierto de formas increíblemente inmersivas. El juego contará con diferentes patrones de corrientes de aire, como brisas terrales (de tierra hacia el mar) después del atardecer y corrientes ascendentes convectivas. En la práctica, las ráfagas de viento harán volar el cabello y los escombros, crearán ondas en la superficie del agua y doblarán la hierba alta de los pantanos. - **Impacto visual persistente:** La lluvia dejará marcas reales en el entorno incluso después de que la tormenta haya pasado. Los charcos duraderos permanecerán en las carreteras indicando la ruta exacta por la que pasó la tormenta, y se podrán formar arcoíris dependiendo de las condiciones precisas de luz solar y humedad. Esta impresionante atención al detalle refuerza el objetivo de Rockstar de crear un mundo abierto mucho más reactivo. La naturaleza en Leonida no servirá solo como un telón de fondo estático, sino como una fuerza activa, impredecible y cambiante durante las rutinas diarias y las exploraciones de Jason y Lucia. ¡Mantente conectado a nuestra web para más actualizaciones y una cobertura completa tan pronto como surja nueva información sobre GTA 6! *Corrección (16 de octubre de 2026): una versión anterior de este artículo hablaba de nubes volumétricas y de brisas marinas después del atardecer. En realidad, Owen Shepherd, de Rockstar, describió formaciones de nubes totalmente dinámicas, brisas terrales (de tierra hacia el mar) después del atardecer y corrientes ascendentes convectivas.*

titulo: GTA 6 Wildlife Blowout: Over 170 Species, Legendary Animals, and Next-Gen Fur Physics Revealed
texto: According to the new details, players will share the open world with over 170 different species of animals, breathing life into the skies, swamps, forests, and oceans of Vice City and its surrounding counties. Here is the breakdown of the wildlife populations confirmed so far: - 60+ types of birds - 30+ land mammals - A diverse array of fish and reptiles **A Next-Generation Ocean Ecosystem** The waters of Leonida won't just be for high-speed jet ski races. Michael Kane, Vice President of Dynamic Art at Rockstar Games, confirmed that the game’s marine life has received a massive overhaul. Players will encounter various species of sharks, whales, rays, sea turtles, and jellyfish. Kane emphasized that each of these marine animals is built with entirely distinct movement behaviors, ensuring the ocean feels as dynamic and unpredictable as the city streets. **Groundbreaking Visuals and Fur Physics** Rockstar is pushing their proprietary engine to its absolute limits for the game's fauna. The article confirms that animals will feature advanced lighting interactions, including iridescence, bioluminescence, and translucency—perfect for the neon-lit waters or the murky depths of the swamps. Furthermore, GTA 6 introduces an entirely new hair and fur simulation system. Animal pelts are now fully simulated and will dynamically react to the environment. Expect to see fur react realistically to water, get caked in mud and dirt, and even experience matting and clumping over time. **Legendary Animals (and a Possible Compendium)** For fans who spent hundreds of hours tracking and studying wildlife in Red Dead Redemption 2, there is incredible news. The GTA 6 animal roster size sits right alongside RDR2's base count of 178 species. Hunting and cataloging have not been confirmed, and neither has an in-game Compendium where players scan animals to register them; for now, those ideas are speculation. What the report does confirm is that wildlife will be divided into different rarity tiers: - Discoverable - Rare - Legendary Rockstar has not revealed which animals are Legendary, but whether you are tracking rare wildlife through the Leonida brush, visiting the newly confirmed in-game Zoos, or just trying to avoid gators in the swamplands, it's clear that the wildlife in GTA 6 is going to be a game within the game. Stay tuned as we continue to break down all the latest GTA 6 news and leaks! *Correction (October 16, 2026): an earlier version of this article called Michael Kane GTA 6's Animation Director and presented hunting, an in-game Compendium for scanning animals and a Legendary Panther as confirmed. In fact, Kane is Rockstar's Vice President of Dynamic Art, and only the Discoverable, Rare and Legendary tiers are confirmed; Rockstar has not revealed which animals are Legendary.*

context: The wildlife figures also come from Game Informer's September 29 cover story. Michael Kane, Rockstar's vice president of dynamic art, said Florida's diverse ecosystem was something the team wanted to “faithfully include across the different biomes in Leonida”. The count is over 170 species, with more than 60 birds and more than 30 land mammals, plus fish, reptiles and sea life.

Comparisons with Red Dead Redemption 2, praised for its wildlife, were immediate, and GTA VI borrows its rarity language. Manatees, flamingos, pelicans and alligators, which outlets note are new to Rockstar games, are among the named species, alongside invasive ones such as green iguanas and rhesus macaques.
known: Rockstar says Leonida has more than 170 animal species, including over 60 birds and over 30 land mammals.
Sea life includes several shark species, whales, rays, sea turtles and jellyfish.
Fur is fully simulated: it changes when wet and clumps when dirty, with color and coat variation within a species.
Materials vary by species, including iridescence, bioluminescence and translucency.
Some animals are grouped as Discoverable, Rare and Legendary; Rockstar has not said which.
unknown: A Red Dead-style compendium where players register animals has not been officially detailed.
Hunting as a system, with pelts or income, has not been confirmed.
The animals in the Legendary tier are still secret.
What the zoo holds and how players interact with it has not been explained.
take: The headline number matters less than the decision to sort animals into tiers. Rarity only means something if there is a reason to go looking, which points to a tracking or collection loop in the spirit of Red Dead Redemption 2, even if Rockstar has not named a compendium. For GTA, that would be a new kind of side activity: quiet, patient, and set in the swamps and keys rather than the city.

The comparisons need some care. Outlets disagree on Red Dead Redemption 2's exact species count, and “170-plus” across birds, fish and reptiles says little about how many animals actually behave differently. The fur simulation and Kane's emphasis on accurately researched animals are the stronger signals, because that work is expensive and only pays off if players look closely. What remains to be seen is whether wildlife changes how people move through Leonida or mostly decorates it. The answer arrives with the game on November 19.

São mais de 170 espécies, com mais de 60 aves e mais de 30 mamíferos terrestres, além de peixes, répteis e vida marinha.

A comparação com Red Dead Redemption 2, elogiado pela fauna, foi imediata, e GTA VI herda a linguagem de raridade. Peixes-boi, flamingos, pelicanos e jacarés, inéditos em jogos da Rockstar segundo a imprensa, estão entre as espécies citadas, ao lado de invasoras como iguanas-verdes e macacos rhesus.

A vida marinha inclui várias espécies de tubarão, baleias, raias, tartarugas-marinhas e águas-vivas.
O pelo é totalmente simulado: muda quando molhado e forma tufos quando sujo, com variação de cor e pelagem dentro da espécie.
Os materiais variam por espécie, com iridescência, bioluminescência e translucidez.
Alguns animais são classificados como Discoverable, Rare e Legendary; a Rockstar não disse quais.

take: O número de espécies importa menos que a decisão de dividir os animais em níveis. Raridade só faz sentido se houver motivo para ir atrás, o que aponta para um ciclo de rastreio ou coleção no espírito de Red Dead Redemption 2, mesmo que a Rockstar não tenha falado em compêndio. Para GTA, seria um tipo novo de atividade paralela: calma, paciente e ambientada nos pântanos e nas ilhas, longe da cidade.

As comparações pedem cuidado. Os veículos divergem sobre o número exato de espécies de Red Dead Redemption 2, e “mais de 170” somando aves, peixes e répteis diz pouco sobre quantos animais de fato se comportam de modo diferente. A simulação de pelo e a ênfase de Kane em animais bem pesquisados são sinais mais fortes, porque esse trabalho é caro e só compensa se o jogador olhar de perto. Falta ver se a fauna muda o jeito de circular por Leonida ou se serve mais de cenário. A resposta chega com o jogo, em 19 de novembro.

titulo_pt: Explosão de Vida Selvagem em GTA 6: Mais de 170 Espécies, Animais Lendários e Física de Pelos de Nova Geração Revelados
texto_pt: O estado de Leonida estará repleto de vida. Uma nova e massiva reportagem da Game Informer acaba de abrir as cortinas sobre o ecossistema em Grand Theft Auto VI, revelando que o jogo apresentará um nível impressionante de biodiversidade que rivaliza, e potencialmente supera, o aclamado ecossistema de Red Dead Redemption 2. De acordo com os novos detalhes, os jogadores dividirão o mundo aberto com mais de 170 espécies diferentes de animais, dando vida aos céus, pântanos, florestas e oceanos de Vice City e seus condados vizinhos. Aqui está o detalhamento das populações de animais confirmadas até o momento: - Mais de 60 tipos de aves - Mais de 30 mamíferos terrestres - Uma grande diversidade de peixes e répteis **Um Ecossistema Oceânico de Nova Geração** As águas de Leonida não servirão apenas para corridas de jet ski em alta velocidade. Michael Kane, vice-presidente de Arte Dinâmica da Rockstar Games, confirmou que a vida marinha do jogo recebeu uma grande reformulação. Os jogadores encontrarão diversas espécies de tubarões, baleias, raias, tartarugas marinhas e águas-vivas. Kane enfatizou que cada um desses animais marinhos foi criado com comportamentos de movimento totalmente distintos, garantindo que o oceano pareça tão dinâmico e imprevisível quanto as ruas da cidade. **Visuais Inovadores e Física de Pelagem** A Rockstar está levando seu motor gráfico ao limite absoluto para a fauna do jogo. A matéria confirma que os animais terão interações avançadas de iluminação, incluindo iridescência, bioluminescência e translucidez — perfeitos para as águas noturnas ou as profundezas turvas dos pântanos. Além disso, GTA 6 introduz um sistema de simulação de cabelo e pelo inteiramente novo. A pelagem dos animais agora é totalmente simulada e reagirá dinamicamente ao ambiente. Espere ver os pelos reagirem de forma realista à água, ficarem cobertos de lama e sujeira, e até mesmo sofrerem emaranhamento e aglomeração (ficar embaraçado) com o tempo. **Animais Lendários (e um Possível Compêndio)** Para os fãs que passaram centenas de horas rastreando e estudando a vida selvagem em Red Dead Redemption 2, há notícias incríveis. O tamanho da lista de animais de GTA 6 está no mesmo patamar da base de 178 espécies de RDR2. A caça e a catalogação ainda não foram confirmadas, nem um Compêndio no jogo para analisar e registrar animais; por enquanto, essas ideias são especulação. O que a reportagem confirma é que a vida selvagem será dividida em diferentes níveis de raridade: - Descobrível - Raro - Lendário A Rockstar não revelou quais animais são lendários, mas, seja rastreando animais raros pela vegetação de Leonida, visitando os recém-confirmados zoológicos do jogo, ou apenas tentando evitar jacarés nos pântanos, fica claro que a vida selvagem em GTA 6 será um jogo dentro do jogo. Fique ligado aqui no site enquanto continuamos a destrinchar todas as últimas notícias e vazamentos de GTA 6! *Correção (16 de outubro de 2026): uma versão anterior deste artigo chamava Michael Kane de Diretor de Animação de GTA 6 e dava como confirmados a caça, um Compêndio para escanear animais e uma Pantera Lendária. Na verdade, Kane é vice-presidente de Arte Dinâmica da Rockstar, e só os níveis Descobrível, Raro e Lendário estão confirmados; a Rockstar não revelou quais animais são lendários.*

De acordo com os novos detalhes, os jogadores dividirão o mundo aberto com mais de 170 espécies diferentes de animais, dando vida aos céus, pântanos, florestas e oceanos de Vice City e seus condados vizinhos.

Aqui está o detalhamento das populações de animais confirmadas até o momento:

  • Mais de 60 tipos de aves

  • Mais de 30 mamíferos terrestres

  • Uma grande diversidade de peixes e répteis

Um Ecossistema Oceânico de Nova Geração
As águas de Leonida não servirão apenas para corridas de jet ski em alta velocidade. Michael Kane, vice-presidente de Arte Dinâmica da Rockstar Games, confirmou que a vida marinha do jogo recebeu uma grande reformulação.

Os jogadores encontrarão diversas espécies de tubarões, baleias, raias, tartarugas marinhas e águas-vivas. Kane enfatizou que cada um desses animais marinhos foi criado com comportamentos de movimento totalmente distintos, garantindo que o oceano pareça tão dinâmico e imprevisível quanto as ruas da cidade.

Visuais Inovadores e Física de Pelagem
A Rockstar está levando seu motor gráfico ao limite absoluto para a fauna do jogo. A matéria confirma que os animais terão interações avançadas de iluminação, incluindo iridescência, bioluminescência e translucidez — perfeitos para as águas noturnas ou as profundezas turvas dos pântanos.

Além disso, GTA 6 introduz um sistema de simulação de cabelo e pelo inteiramente novo. A pelagem dos animais agora é totalmente simulada e reagirá dinamicamente ao ambiente. Espere ver os pelos reagirem de forma realista à água, ficarem cobertos de lama e sujeira, e até mesmo sofrerem emaranhamento e aglomeração (ficar embaraçado) com o tempo.

Animais Lendários (e um Possível Compêndio)
Para os fãs que passaram centenas de horas rastreando e estudando a vida selvagem em Red Dead Redemption 2, há notícias incríveis. O tamanho da lista de animais de GTA 6 está no mesmo patamar da base de 178 espécies de RDR2.

A caça e a catalogação ainda não foram confirmadas, nem um Compêndio no jogo para analisar e registrar animais; por enquanto, essas ideias são especulação. O que a reportagem confirma é que a vida selvagem será dividida em diferentes níveis de raridade:

  • Descobrível

  • Raro

  • Lendário

A Rockstar não revelou quais animais são lendários, mas, seja rastreando animais raros pela vegetação de Leonida, visitando os recém-confirmados zoológicos do jogo, ou apenas tentando evitar jacarés nos pântanos, fica claro que a vida selvagem em GTA 6 será um jogo dentro do jogo.

Fique ligado aqui no site enquanto continuamos a destrinchar todas as últimas notícias e vazamentos de GTA 6!

Correção (16 de outubro de 2026): uma versão anterior deste artigo chamava Michael Kane de Diretor de Animação de GTA 6 e dava como confirmados a caça, um Compêndio para escanear animais e uma Pantera Lendária. Na verdade, Kane é vice-presidente de Arte Dinâmica da Rockstar, e só os níveis Descobrível, Raro e Lendário estão confirmados; a Rockstar não revelou quais animais são lendários.

titulo: GTA 6 Confirmed Side Activities: From Kayaking to Zoo Visits!
texto: The newly confirmed list of minigames and side activities proves Rockstar Games is laser-focused on delivering their most immersive and lived-in open world to date. Here are the side activities confirmed so far (Game Informer notes the list is only partial): - Base jumping: Classic skydiving returns, offering the perfect way to take advantage of Vice City's towering skyline. - Billiards: Leonida’s dive bars could feature pool tables where you can kick back and relax; whether you can hustle locals for cash hasn't been revealed. - Gyms: The beloved workout system is back, heavily hinting that physical character customization—a fan-favorite feature from GTA: San Andreas—is making a return. - Kayaking: Possibly a quiet, low-key way to navigate the dense, winding swamps and rivers outside the city limits. - Mini Golf: The ultimate downtime distraction between intense story missions. - Scuba diving: Leonida’s ocean floor could be rich in detail; shipwreck exploration and deep-sea scavenging would be natural fits, but Rockstar hasn't confirmed them. - Street and off-road racing: The core DNA of the franchise lives on with underground sprint races on the asphalt and mud-kicking rallies in the backcountry. - Zoos: A highly unexpected first for the series. While we don't know the full extent of our interaction with the animals yet, it adds an entirely new layer of life to the map. - Air boating: The quintessential Florida-inspired vehicle, perfect for tearing across gator-infested swamplands like the Everglades. - Jet skiing: High-speed coastal racing and exploration across Vice City's pristine beaches. This diverse lineup shows the new game will lean heavily into the local culture of the state, perfectly blending chaotic urban life with wild, untamed nature. The specific additions of airboats, zoos, and kayaking suggest that Leonida's wildlife and waterways will play a massive role in the player's day-to-day experience. Keep it locked right here for full coverage and updates the second more GTA 6 news drops! *Correction (October 16, 2026): an earlier version of this article presented the list as every side activity and described details such as hustling locals at pool, stealthy kayaking and shipwreck exploration as facts. In fact, Game Informer notes the list is partial and only named the activities; those details are not confirmed.*

context: This list comes from Game Informer's Grand Theft Auto VI cover story, published on September 29, 2026. The magazine named ten activities: base jumping, billiards, gyms, kayaking, mini golf, scuba diving, street and off-road racing, zoos, airboating and jet skiing. It gave little detail on how any of them work. The same coverage said Leonida holds more than 170 animal species, from over 60 bird types and 30-plus land mammals to manatees, sharks and whales, with some labelled Rare, Discoverable or Legendary.

The list builds on the Netflix Extended Look shown in late August and on Rob Nelson's interviews, in which he said workouts build visible muscle and food affects Jason and Lucia's weight. GTA VI launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
known: Game Informer's September 29 cover story names ten side activities, including kayaking, scuba diving, mini golf, airboating and zoo visits.
Leonida has more than 170 animal species, including over 60 bird types and more than 30 land mammals.
Rockstar's Michael Kane said the studio wanted to include Florida's animal ecosystem faithfully across Leonida's different biomes.
Rob Nelson has said working out builds visible muscle and food affects weight, so gyms are tied to a body system.
Leonida is split into six regions: Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga.
unknown: Rockstar has not explained what players can actually do at a zoo beyond visiting it.
It is unclear whether races, dives or kayak trips come with rewards, missions or leaderboards.
The list is not complete: Insider Gaming stressed that these are only some of the activities, and backyard wrestling seen in earlier footage is not on it.
Shipwrecks or other underwater points of interest have not been confirmed.
take: The familiar entries are the least interesting part of this list. Street racing, jet skis and base jumping have been part of GTA for years. What stands out is how much of the rest involves water and wildlife: kayaks, airboats, scuba gear, zoos. Read alongside the 170-plus species, that suggests Rockstar wants Grassrivers and the Keys to be places where players spend time, not just scenery between story missions.

A list of names is not a design, though. Game Informer offered almost no detail on how these activities play, and descriptions circulating online, from shipwreck diving to hustling pool players, are guesses. San Andreas showed back in 2004 that side content matters most when it feeds back into the character, and the gym is the one item here with a confirmed link to Jason and Lucia's bodies. Before launch, the thing to watch is whether zoos and diving get their own progression or exist mainly as places to look at animals.

The newly confirmed list of minigames and side activities proves Rockstar Games is laser-focused on delivering their most immersive and lived-in open world to date.

Here are the side activities confirmed so far (Game Informer notes the list is only partial):

  • Base jumping: Classic skydiving returns, offering the perfect way to take advantage of Vice City's towering skyline.

  • Billiards: Leonida’s dive bars could feature pool tables where you can kick back and relax; whether you can hustle locals for cash hasn't been revealed.

  • Gyms: The beloved workout system is back, heavily hinting that physical character customization—a fan-favorite feature from GTA: San Andreas—is making a return.

  • Kayaking: Possibly a quiet, low-key way to navigate the dense, winding swamps and rivers outside the city limits.

  • Mini Golf: The ultimate downtime distraction between intense story missions.

  • Scuba diving: Leonida’s ocean floor could be rich in detail; shipwreck exploration and deep-sea scavenging would be natural fits, but Rockstar hasn't confirmed them.

  • Street and off-road racing: The core DNA of the franchise lives on with underground sprint races on the asphalt and mud-kicking rallies in the backcountry.

  • Air boating: The quintessential Florida-inspired vehicle, perfect for tearing across gator-infested swamplands like the Everglades.

  • Jet skiing: High-speed coastal racing and exploration across Vice City's pristine beaches.

This diverse lineup shows the new game will lean heavily into the local culture of the state, perfectly blending chaotic urban life with wild, untamed nature. titulo_pt: Lista de Atividades Confirmadas em GTA 6: De Caiaque a Visitas ao Zoológico!
texto_pt: A espera por mais detalhes de Grand Theft Auto VI acaba de ficar ainda mais empolgante. A conceituada revista americana Game Informer revelou novos detalhes do jogo, confirmando uma tonelada de novidades sobre o que poderemos fazer no estado de Leonida quando não estivermos focados na história principal. Entre as confirmações da matéria, a lista de minigames e atividades secundárias impressiona pela variedade. A Rockstar Games parece estar focada em entregar o mundo aberto mais imersivo e cheio de vida já feito pelo estúdio. Confira as atividades confirmadas até o momento (a própria Game Informer diz que a lista é parcial): - Base jumping: O clássico salto de paraquedas retorna, perfeito para explorar a verticalidade dos arranha-céus de Vice City. - Sinuca (Billiards): As noites nos bares de Leonida podem ter a clássica mesa de sinuca para relaxar (se vai dar para apostar dinheiro, ainda não foi revelado). - Academias (Gyms): O amado sistema de treinos está de volta, sugerindo que poderemos moldar o corpo dos personagens, assim como em GTA San Andreas. - Caiaque (Kayaking): Possivelmente uma forma tranquila de explorar os densos pântanos e rios do mapa. - Mini Golf: O passatempo perfeito para quem quer desacelerar entre um roubo e outro. - Mergulho (Scuba diving): O fundo do mar de Leonida pode ser rico em detalhes; explorar naufrágios e cavernas submarinas seria algo natural, mas a Rockstar ainda não confirmou isso. - Corridas de rua e off-road: A essência da franquia continua viva com competições clandestinas no asfalto e na terra. - Zoológicos (Zoos): Uma novidade inusitada para a franquia. Ainda não sabemos o nível de interação com os animais, mas certamente trará um toque extra de vida à cidade. - Aerobarco (Air boating): O veículo definitivo e mais autêntico para cruzar os pântanos infestados de crocodilos (inspirados nos Everglades da Flórida). - Jet ski: Corridas e exploração em alta velocidade pelas praias paradisíacas da costa leste. Essa seleção de atividades mostra que o novo jogo vai explorar ao máximo a cultura local do estado, misturando a vida urbana agitada com a natureza selvagem da região. A inclusão de aerobarcos, zoológicos e caiaques sugere que a fauna e os corpos d'água terão um papel central na experiência do jogador. Fiquem ligados aqui no site para mais atualizações e coberturas completas assim que novas informações sobre GTA 6 surgirem! *Correção (16 de outubro de 2026): uma versão anterior deste artigo apresentava a lista como completa e tratava como fatos detalhes como apostar dinheiro na sinuca, caiaque furtivo e exploração de naufrágios. Na verdade, a Game Informer diz que a lista é parcial e só citou os nomes das atividades; esses detalhes não foram confirmados.*

titulo: GTA 6 Collector's Box Revealed: What's Inside the $399.99 Goodtime State – Vice City Collection
texto: Rockstar Games revealed on Thursday, September 24, 2026 the first collector's product for Grand Theft Auto VI: **The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection**. Sold through the Rockstar Store for **$399.99** (also listed at £349.99, €399.99 and CA$559.99), the box is limited to one per customer. The collection is built around the Leonida Keys and Vice City, the two regions where Jason and Lucia's story takes place, and every item is officially licensed merchandise themed after the game's fictional version of Florida. Check out everything inside the box: - **Macca the gator figure:** A collectible statue of the gator mascot seen across Leonida, with a twist-open base. - **Oakley® Frogskins™ sunglasses:** A themed pair of the classic Oakley frames, matching the beach look of the Keys. - **New Era® 9FORTY cap:** An adjustable cap with Leonida branding. - **Leonida Keys crossbody bag:** A shoulder bag inspired by the island chain where Jason starts the game. - **Small collectibles:** A Macca the gator magnetic mirror, a Chunkee the Manatee shot glass, a collectible Vice City swizzle spoon and a razor-blade keychain. - **Pins, stickers and poster:** A set of nine Leonida Keys enamel pins in a metal tin, a sticker pack and a double-sided souvenir poster with the map of Leonida. **Important: the game is NOT included.** The Goodtime State is a merchandise box only, with no download code. GTA VI itself is sold separately and launches on November 19, 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, so a fan who wants both the box and the standard edition of the game should budget close to $480. Fan reaction was mixed, mostly because of the price and the missing game. For collectors, though, it is the most complete set of official Leonida merchandise Rockstar has released so far, and the map poster is one of the first physical looks at the state's full layout. Want to compare every edition and price before you buy? Read our guide: [GTA 6 editions, prices and pre-orders](https://vvviceversa.com/guides/gta-6-editions-prices-pre-order/). Below, the official images of every item in the collection: Stay tuned to our website for more updates and full coverage as soon as new information about GTA 6 emerges!

context: The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection is Rockstar's first large physical product for GTA VI, and it surfaced in an unusual way. On September 24, Insider Gaming reported that a datamined list of 55 Rockstar Store items included the box, possibly limited to one per person; Rockstar opened pre-orders the same day.

It sits outside the two game editions Rockstar announced in June: the $79.99 Standard Edition and the $99.99 Ultimate Edition, with pre-orders that opened on June 25. Unlike the collector's editions of many big releases, the box contains no copy of the game and no download code. Reports say deliveries are due to start around the November 19 launch, with shipping and import duties charged separately.
known: The box costs $399.99, £349.99 or €399.99 and is sold through the Rockstar Store.
It does not include GTA VI or a download code; the game is sold separately.
Headline items are a six-inch Macca the Gator figure with a twist-open stash base, Oakley Frogskins sunglasses with Prizm Sapphire lenses, a New Era 9FORTY cap and a Leonida Keys crossbody bag.
Smaller items include nine enamel pins in a metal tin, a sticker pack and a double-sided poster with a map of Leonida.
Guru3D reports a limit of one box per customer, matching what the earlier datamine suggested.
unknown: Rockstar has not said how many boxes were made or whether there will be restocks.
Exact delivery dates by region are unclear; reports only place the first shipments around launch.
It is not confirmed whether the poster map shows Leonida exactly as it appears in the final game.
The datamined list had 55 store items, and Rockstar has not said when, or whether, the rest will go on sale.
take: Four hundred dollars for merchandise without the game is a hard sell, and the reaction in Push Square's comments was mostly negative. Much of the value rests on the Oakleys and the New Era cap, branded items with appeal outside GTA. The rest is souvenir material: shot glass, swizzle spoon, mirror, keychain. Within a day, fans were sharing 3D-printable files of the Macca figure, which says a lot about how much of the price is the logo.

For most players the practical point is simpler. This is not a collector's edition in the usual sense, and pairing it with the Standard Edition comes to roughly $480 before shipping and taxes. The razor-blade keychain and the hidden stash fit Rockstar's satirical tone, though they also make this an adult collectible rather than a gift for younger fans. If the box sells out quickly despite the price, expect more premium merchandise around launch; if it lingers, that would be a rare sign of where GTA fans draw the line.

O chaveiro de lâmina e o esconderijo na base combinam com a sátira da Rockstar, mas também fazem disso um item para adultos. titulo: Is the GTA 6 Map Bigger Than Leonida? An Old Puerto Rico Rumor Resurfaces After the 192GB Leak
texto: Ever since the 192GB archive of old Rockstar material surfaced online on September 18, 2026, fans have been combing through early GTA 6 map files, which Kotaku dates to around 2015 (only MMOCulture mentions 2014). Among the theories spreading in the community, an old one has resurfaced: a fan rumor, first posted on 4chan in 2021, about an island inspired by **Puerto Rico**, which would point to a playable area outside the state of Leonida. The idea is not new for the series. In GTA 5, the snowy town of North Yankton appeared only in specific story missions, far from Los Santos. Fans suggest a Caribbean island could play a similar role in GTA 6, especially because of Lucia's Latin roots. Here is what we know, and what we don't: - **What is confirmed:** Rockstar has only officially presented the state of Leonida, with six regions: Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga. - **What the leak shows:** Outlets that analysed the archive describe an early Leonida prototype, with labels such as "Alligator Farm", "Coast Guard" and "Disused Theme Park", plus early Vice City assets. - **What remains unverified:** None of the outlets we checked mention a Puerto Rico-style island. The theory is an old fan rumor from 2021, not something found in the leaked files. - **Why caution matters:** The files are about a decade old. Even the coverage of the leak stresses that a prototype of that age cannot confirm the final map's roads, borders or playable locations. That is why this story carries our **Rumor** badge. An extra island, accessed only during a mission, would be a fun surprise and fits Rockstar's history, but there is no official sign of it. Rockstar has not commented on the leak. GTA VI launches November 19, 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Until then, everything confirmed about the state is in our guide: [the GTA 6 map and Leonida's regions](https://vvviceversa.com/guides/gta-6-map-leonida-regions/). Stay tuned to our website for more updates and full coverage as soon as new information about GTA 6 emerges! *Correction (October 16, 2026): an earlier version of this article said fans had found renders of a Puerto Rico-style island in leaked files dated to around 2014–2015. In fact, the Puerto Rico idea is an old fan rumor from 4chan (2021) that no reputable outlet has linked to the leak, and Kotaku dates the map to around 2015.*

context: The 192GB archive that began circulating on September 18 is not a new hack. TweakTown reported that the files are believed to come from Rockstar's 2022 breach, the same incident that put roughly 90 early GTA VI development videos online. Most of the material concerns GTA V; the GTA VI content is limited to low-quality early map renders.

It is also the second leak in two months. In August, gameplay footage spread online ahead of the Netflix Extended Look, and on August 26 Rockstar said the leak had been heartbreaking for its team and that the game was nearly finished. The November 19 release date has not moved.
known: The archive surfaced on September 18, 2026, and reports link it to Rockstar's 2022 security breach rather than a new intrusion.
Most of the files relate to GTA V, including a cut Liberty City expansion and the abandoned Agent Trevor DLC.
The GTA VI material consists of rough, early map renders that some users say resemble locations from the official trailers.
Rockstar's official setting is the state of Leonida, with six regions: Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga.
Rockstar publicly addressed the August gameplay leak; none of the outlets we checked reported a statement on the 192GB archive.
unknown: No reputable outlet we checked has reported a Puerto Rico-style island in the files; the theory comes from fan posts, and the renders shared online are not authenticated.
The age of the GTA VI map files is uncertain: one report dates the prototype to around 2014 or 2015, while Notebookcheck said the models may have been built before 2020.
Reports disagree on whether the archive comes from the 2022 breach or overlaps with the 2023 GTA V source code leak.
Rockstar has not said whether any playable area exists outside Leonida.
take: We don't consider the island theory a credible guide to the final game. The evidence is a handful of fan-circulated renders that no outlet has authenticated, taken from files that are years old and were made long before the game reached its current form. Early prototypes routinely contain areas that never ship. The same archive's Liberty City expansion for GTA V, planned and then dropped, is a reminder of how much Rockstar sketches and later abandons.

There is a stronger argument against the idea: Rockstar has been specific about Leonida. It has named six regions, given each a distinct identity and built its marketing around a fictional Florida. A story-only detour in the style of North Yankton in GTA V is not impossible, but nothing official points to one. Until Rockstar says otherwise, the sensible approach is to treat any map image from this archive as a look at the game's history, not a preview of what ships on November 19.

É também o segundo vazamento em dois meses. Em agosto, vídeos de gameplay circularam antes do Extended Look da Netflix, e em 26 de agosto a Rockstar disse que o vazamento foi doloroso para a equipe e que o jogo estava quase pronto. A data de 19 de novembro não mudou.

La antigüedad de los archivos del mapa es incierta: un reporte fecha el prototipo hacia 2014 o 2015, mientras que Notebookcheck dijo que los modelos podrían ser anteriores a 2020.

titulo: Stephen Root Confirms He's in GTA 6, Widely Believed to Voice Brian Heder: "You're Gonna See Me in There"
texto: American actor **Stephen Root** has confirmed that he is in Grand Theft Auto VI, making him the first member of the cast to publicly go on record about a role in the game. He did not name his character, but fans and the press, who recognized his voice, widely believe he plays **Brian Heder**. Root spoke to the Associated Press at the BAFTA TV Tea Party in mid-September 2026. Asked about GTA 6, he did not dodge the question: "You're gonna see me in there." He also admitted that keeping the secret had become almost impossible, because fans had already recognized him: "There were too many people that knew me from King of the Hill and my voice." Check out what we know about the actor and his character: - **Who is Brian Heder:** According to Rockstar's official profile, Brian is an old-school drug runner in the Leonida Keys who lets Jason live in one of his properties in exchange for help with his business. In other words, he is one of the first people players will meet, since the story begins in the Keys. - **Who is Stephen Root:** A veteran character actor known as Milton in *Office Space*, Monroe Fuches in *Barry*, and the voices of Bill Dauterive and Buck Strickland in the animated series *King of the Hill*. - **How fans found out:** Players began linking the voice to Root as soon as Brian was introduced in the second trailer, in May 2025. The Extended Look shown in August 2026 gave him more screen time and turned the guess into near-certainty. - **What is still a secret:** Rockstar has not officially announced the cast, and the actors behind Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos remain unconfirmed. Root's comments suggest the studio is relaxing its famously tight secrecy as launch approaches. More cast reveals, official or not, are likely in the coming weeks. Meet the rest of the characters in our guide: [Jason, Lucia and the GTA 6 cast](https://vvviceversa.com/guides/gta-6-characters-jason-lucia/). GTA VI launches November 19, 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Stay tuned to our website for more updates and full coverage as soon as new information about GTA 6 emerges! *Correction (October 16, 2026): an earlier version of this article said Stephen Root confirmed he plays Brian Heder. In fact, Root confirmed he is in the game but did not name his character; the link to Brian Heder comes from fans and the press, who recognized his voice.*

context: Rockstar has never published a cast list for GTA VI, so Stephen Root's remarks to the Associated Press are the first time an actor has publicly placed himself in the game. Speaking at the BAFTA Tea Party in Beverly Hills, in the same stretch in which he won an Emmy for Apple TV's Widow's Bay, Root said: "Yeah, you're gonna see me in there." He added that his character had been part of the game's first rollout almost a year earlier.

Fans had tied Brian Heder's voice to Root since the character appeared in the second trailer on May 6, 2025. Root did not say the name himself. The Brian Heder link comes from that fan identification, which Variety and other outlets now treat as settled.

Rockstar's character guide describes Brian Heder as a classic drug runner from the golden age of smuggling in the Keys, still moving product through his boatyard with his third wife, Lori.
Brian appears in the Extended Look meeting Jason and Lucia at a rooftop party and sharing a cigar with Jason.
Root was born and raised in Florida and studied at the University of Florida, according to Variety.
Rockstar has not officially named any cast member and did not comment on Root's remarks.

Rockstar has not said whether it will share cast details before the November 19 launch.
take: The Brian Heder identification is about as close to certain as it gets without Rockstar's word. Root confirmed he is in the game, placed his character in the first wave of promotion and pointed to the King of the Hill voice that gave him away, and no other character from those trailers has been tied to him. Still, the specific claim rests on inference. Headlines saying he confirmed the name go one step further than he did.

The more telling part is that he spoke at all. Rockstar has kept GTA VI's cast off the record through two trailers and the Extended Look, and an Emmy winner talking openly to a wire service suggests that wall is getting harder to hold this close to launch. The casting also fits the role Rockstar describes: Root's best-known work, from Barry to King of the Hill, leans on comic, slightly shady characters, and he has real Florida roots. Watch for more actors to talk as launch nears, though the leads are the reveals that matter.

titulo: GTA 6 Daily Life Detailed: A Physical Phone, a Shared Hideout and Protected Story Locations
texto: With 65 days to go until launch, Rockstar keeps revealing how life in Leonida will work between missions. In a long interview with the Japanese magazine **Famitsu**, translated into English by GTAVice, **Rob Nelson**, head of development and co-studio head at Rockstar North, described the small systems that make Jason and Lucia's routine feel lived-in. The common thread is realism: objects exist physically in the world, the couple's home behaves like a real home, and the open world respects the needs of the story. Check out the main highlights of the new details: - **A phone you actually hold:** The cell phone is now a physical object in Jason and Lucia's hands instead of a flat 2D overlay, as it was in GTA V. Rockstar mentioned apps for video, fitness tracking, banking, social media and "Scooter Bros", a vehicle delivery service. - **Photos, but no posting:** Jason and Lucia can send photos to each other. Because both are on the run, though, they cannot upload anything to social media; they can only follow other accounts. - **A home that feels shared:** The hideout is treated as a place where two people live. In the demo shown to Famitsu, Jason pulls back the covers and climbs into bed next to a sleeping Lucia. You also can't toss objects anywhere: Nelson explained that a mug has to be carried to a place where it can properly be put down. - **Protected story locations:** As in Red Dead Redemption 2, some places that matter to the story are off-limits for crime. Nelson's example: you can't steal cars outside the strip club owned by Jason's friend Dre'Quan, so players can't accidentally ruin a location the story still needs. - **A body to look after:** How you play changes Jason and Lucia's bodies. Training builds muscle, overeating can make them gain weight, and food gives temporary boosts to their health and stamina meters. Together, these details point to a slower, more grounded GTA, closer to the daily rhythm of Red Dead Redemption 2 than to the arcade feel of earlier games. For everything confirmed about money, gyms and hideouts, read our guide: [GTA 6 gameplay: money, gym and hideouts](https://vvviceversa.com/guides/gta-6-gameplay-money-gym-hideouts/). GTA VI launches November 19, 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Stay tuned to our website for more updates and full coverage as soon as new information about GTA 6 emerges!

context: The Famitsu interview, conducted at Rockstar North in Edinburgh and published in English by GTAVice on September 9, is one of several long conversations Rob Nelson gave around the late-August Extended Look. In Dazed, he said food would affect Jason and Lucia's weight, workouts would build visible muscle and lack of sleep would show in their faces. In IGN's interview, later republished in full, he said the couple can only browse the Snapmatic social app because they are fugitives, and compared GTA VI's safehouses to the camps in Red Dead Redemption 2.
Read together, the interviews describe one design direction from different angles: more physical interaction, fewer abstract menus and a world that keeps track of what you do.
known: Nelson told Famitsu the phone is now a physical object in the world rather than GTA V's 2D overlay, with video, fitness and banking apps and a car delivery service called Scooter Bros.
Jason and Lucia can send each other photos but cannot post on social media; in IGN's interview Nelson summed it up as "You just lurk."
Car theft is blocked around hideouts and at some story locations, such as outside the strip club owned by Jason's friend Dre'Quan.
Workouts build muscle and overeating leads to weight gain, a point Nelson made to Famitsu, Dazed and IGN.
Food and drink give temporary boosts, such as an energy drink raising stamina, while training raises base health and stamina.
unknown: How much body changes affect gameplay beyond health and stamina has not been detailed.
Rockstar has not listed the protected locations or explained how the game tells players where crime is restricted.
The full list of phone apps, and whether new ones unlock during the story, is unknown.
take: These details matter more than they look. A phone that exists in the hand, a mug that needs a surface, cars you cannot steal outside a friend's club: each is a small rule that trades convenience for coherence. Red Dead Redemption 2 was built on the same trade, and Nelson's comparison of safehouses to its camps suggests Rockstar is comfortable carrying that philosophy into a series known for chaos.

The protected-locations rule is the most practical of them. It solves a real problem, players wrecking a place the story still needs, by restricting freedom in a narrow way instead of breaking a mission later. The risk is in the signalling: an unexplained no-theft zone around a strip club could feel arbitrary. The body system is the other one to watch. San Andreas tied fitness to play back in 2004, and GTA VI now has to show that eating and training matter beyond what players see in the mirror.

À Dazed, ele disse que a comida afeta o peso de Jason e Lucia, que malhar gera músculos visíveis e que noites sem dormir aparecem no rosto. Lidas juntas, as entrevistas descrevem a mesma direção por ângulos diferentes: mais interação física, menos menus abstratos e um mundo que registra o que você faz.

A lista completa de apps do celular, e se novos são liberados ao longo da história, é desconhecida.

Um celular que existe na mão, uma caneca que precisa de uma superfície, carros que não dá para roubar na porta da boate de um amigo: cada um é uma pequena regra que troca conveniência por coerência. Red Dead Redemption 2 foi construído sobre essa mesma troca, e a comparação de Nelson entre os esconderijos e os acampamentos indica que a Rockstar está à vontade para levar essa filosofia a uma série famosa pelo caos.

A regra dos locais protegidos é a mais prática delas. Resolve um problema real, o jogador destruir um lugar de que a história ainda precisa, limitando a liberdade de forma pontual em vez de quebrar uma missão depois. O risco está na sinalização: uma zona sem roubo de carro na frente de uma boate, sem explicação, pode parecer arbitrária. O sistema de corpo é o outro ponto de atenção. San Andreas já ligava forma física ao gameplay em 2004, e GTA VI agora precisa mostrar que comer e treinar importam além do espelho.

In a long interview with the Japanese magazine Famitsu, translated into English by GTAVice, Rob Nelson, head of development and co-studio head at Rockstar North, described the small systems that make Jason and Lucia's routine feel lived-in.

The common thread is realism: objects exist physically in the world, the couple's home behaves like a real home, and the open world respects the needs of the story.

Check out the main highlights of the new details:

  • A phone you actually hold:
    The cell phone is now a physical object in Jason and Lucia's hands instead of a flat 2D overlay, as it was in GTA V. Rockstar mentioned apps for video, fitness tracking, banking, social media and "Scooter Bros", a vehicle delivery service.

  • Photos, but no posting:
    Jason and Lucia can send photos to each other. Because both are on the run, though, they cannot upload anything to social media; they can only follow other accounts.

    As in Red Dead Redemption 2, some places that matter to the story are off-limits for crime. Nelson's example: you can't steal cars outside the strip club owned by Jason's friend Dre'Quan, so players can't accidentally ruin a location the story still needs.

  • A body to look after:
    How you play changes Jason and Lucia's bodies. Training builds muscle, overeating can make them gain weight, and food gives temporary boosts to their health and stamina meters.

titulo_pt: Vida diária em GTA 6: celular físico, esconderijo compartilhado e locais protegidos da história
texto_pt: A 65 dias do lançamento, a Rockstar segue revelando como vai funcionar a vida em Leonida entre uma missão e outra. Em uma longa entrevista à revista japonesa **Famitsu**, traduzida para o inglês pelo GTAVice, **Rob Nelson**, chefe de desenvolvimento e codiretor da Rockstar North, descreveu os pequenos sistemas que dão vida à rotina de Jason e Lucia. O fio condutor é o realismo: os objetos existem de verdade no mundo, a casa do casal funciona como uma casa de verdade e o mundo aberto respeita as necessidades da história. Confira os principais destaques das novidades: - **Um celular que você segura:** O celular agora é um objeto físico nas mãos de Jason e Lucia, e não uma camada 2D sobre a tela, como em GTA V. A Rockstar citou aplicativos de vídeo, acompanhamento de exercícios, banco, redes sociais e o "Scooter Bros", um serviço de entrega de veículos. - **Fotos, mas sem postar:** Jason e Lucia podem enviar fotos um para o outro. Como os dois estão fugindo, porém, não podem publicar nada nas redes sociais; só podem seguir outras contas. - **Uma casa de verdade, dividida a dois:** O esconderijo é tratado como o lugar onde duas pessoas moram. Na demonstração mostrada à Famitsu, Jason puxa o cobertor e deita ao lado de Lucia, que está dormindo. Também não dá para largar objetos em qualquer lugar: segundo Nelson, uma caneca precisa ser levada até um lugar onde possa ser colocada direito. - **Locais protegidos da história:** Como em Red Dead Redemption 2, alguns lugares importantes para a história não permitem crimes. O exemplo de Nelson: não dá para roubar carros na porta da boate de striptease de Dre'Quan, amigo de Jason, para que o jogador não estrague sem querer um local que a história ainda vai usar. - **Um corpo para cuidar:** O jeito de jogar muda o corpo de Jason e Lucia. Treinar ganha músculos, comer demais pode fazer engordar, e a comida dá bônus temporários aos medidores de vida e de fôlego. Juntos, esses detalhes apontam para um GTA mais calmo e pé no chão, mais perto do ritmo diário de Red Dead Redemption 2 do que do estilo arcade dos jogos anteriores. titulo: Miami Beach Votes to Negotiate GTA 6 Marketing Deal: 'Vice City' Beach Ads Proposed From October 15
texto: Vice City is about to take over the real Miami Beach. On September 10, 2026, the **Miami Beach City Commission** voted 4–3 to authorize negotiations on a marketing deal that would bring Grand Theft Auto VI branding to the city's beaches ahead of the game's launch. As of October 12, the contract had still not been signed, according to reporter Joel Franco via GTA BOOM. The approval came after a heated debate. Commissioner David Suarez opposed the deal, showed footage from the game during the session and said he did not want the city's brand associated with it. Separately, Miami-Dade Sheriff Rosie Cordero-Stutz had criticized a different GTA 6 promotion proposed to Miami-Dade County, pointing to the series' focus on crime. Supporters, like Commissioner Monica Matteo-Salinas, argued that enjoying fiction is not the same as endorsing crime, and stressed the financial benefit for the city. Check out the main proposed terms of the campaign: - **Where the ads will appear:** Only on private beach equipment, the chairs and umbrellas run by the concessionaire Boucher Brothers. No Rockstar branding will go on city property such as lifeguard stands. - **What they will show:** The ads are limited to the Roman numeral "VI" and the name "Vice City", described as discreet placements. - **When:** The proposal calls for **October 15 to December 31, 2026**, covering the November 19 launch and the holiday season, but with the contract still unsigned, the start date will likely slip. - **How much:** Reports put the value of the deal in the millions of dollars, with Beebom citing about $3 million. The campaign is not limited to the beach. On September 14, a photo shared on Reddit showed large advertising panels laid out behind the Kaseya Center, the Miami Heat's arena in downtown Miami, which turned out to form a "Welcome to Vice City" sign. It was installed on the arena's roof on September 22 as part of a separate $975,000 deal with Miami-Dade County. Miami is the real-world inspiration for Vice City, and Rockstar seems ready to make the most of it. If you are in Florida this fall, expect to see the city and the game blend together. To learn how Vice City fits into the state of Leonida, read our guide: [the GTA 6 map and Leonida's regions](https://vvviceversa.com/guides/gta-6-map-leonida-regions/). Stay tuned to our website for more updates and full coverage as soon as new information about GTA 6 emerges! *Correction (October 16, 2026): an earlier version of this article said Miami Beach approved the deal, that the sheriff criticized it and that the Kaseya Center sign would read "Welcome to VI." In fact, the 4–3 vote only authorized negotiations, the contract was still unsigned as of October 12, the sheriff criticized a separate Miami-Dade County proposal, and the sign reads "Welcome to Vice City."*

context: The Miami Beach vote is part of a wider push to turn the real Miami into a billboard for Vice City before the November 19 launch. In early September, the Miami Herald reported that Miami-Dade County had discussed ideas such as “Welcome to Vice City” messages at Miami International Airport and branded Metromover cars, which led Sheriff Rosie Cordero-Stutz to object in public. The county also approved, without a commission vote, a $975,000 “Welcome to Vice City” sign on the roof of the Kaseya Center, which went up in September.

What Miami Beach approved on September 10 was the authority to negotiate, not a signed contract. Commissioners discussed a fee of about $3 million, and one suggested it could get closer to $4 million.
known: On September 10, 2026, the Miami Beach City Commission voted 4–3 to open negotiations on a GTA VI marketing campaign.
The planned branding is limited to “VI” and “Vice City” on beach chairs and umbrellas run by the concessionaire Boucher Brothers, not on city buildings.
The campaign window discussed runs from October 15 to the end of 2026, covering the November 19 launch.
In October, county commissioners postponed a broader proposal covering the airport, PortMiami and transit, and required any Rockstar deal above $1 million to come back to them.
unknown: As of October 12, a report citing a city official said the Miami Beach contract had not been signed, so the October 15 start may slip.
The final fee Miami Beach will receive has not been made public.
Whether any county property, such as Miami International Airport, will carry GTA VI branding remains open; Mayor Daniella Levine Cava says talks continue.
take: The beach chairs are the least interesting part of this story. The real question is how closely Rockstar can tie GTA VI to a real city, and how much pushback it gets. So far the pattern is clear: local governments like the money but get nervous once the branding moves onto public property. Miami Beach confined it to a private concessionaire's umbrellas, and the county approved a sign priced just under the threshold that would have required a vote, then stalled on the airport and transit ideas.

For readers, the practical point is that the September vote was a first step, not a finished deal. Early coverage, ours included, presented October 15 as a fixed start date, and that now looks uncertain. Two things are worth watching before launch: whether Miami Beach signs in time to matter, and whether the county proposal returns to the agenda. Discreet “VI” logos can survive a short delay. A campaign timed to a release date cannot wait much longer.

unknown: Em 12 de outubro, uma reportagem que citava um funcionário da cidade dizia que o contrato de Miami Beach ainda não estava assinado, então o início em 15 de outubro pode atrasar.

take: As cadeiras de praia são o detalhe menos interessante dessa história. A questão de fundo é até onde a Rockstar consegue colar GTA VI em uma cidade de verdade, e quanta resistência encontra no caminho. Para o leitor, o ponto prático é que a votação de setembro foi um primeiro passo, não um acordo fechado. A cobertura inicial, incluindo a nossa, tratou 15 de outubro como data certa, e isso agora parece incerto. Vale acompanhar duas coisas até o lançamento: se Miami Beach assina a tempo de fazer diferença e se a proposta do condado volta à pauta. Logotipos discretos de “VI” aguentam um pequeno atraso. Uma campanha pensada para a semana de lançamento não pode esperar muito mais.
